defs.def: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time 传统的；习俗的；惯例的

ex.s: Furthermore, AI-powered virtual guides are replacing traditional tour guides.
ex.t: 此外，人工智能驱动的虚拟导游正在取代传统导游。

ex.s: It is also common for them _____56_____ (hold) during traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as other local festivals.
ex.t: 在春节,中____56____秋节等中国传统节日,以及其它当地节日中,他们也常见.

ex.s: Don’t leave the harbor without a traditional Cornish pie.
ex.t: 离开港口前，别忘了尝一个传统的康沃尔馅饼。

ex.s: Compared to traditional garden plots, they increase carbon absorption, reduce stormwater runoff and boost habitat and biodiversity significantly.
ex.t: 相比传统园圃，它们增加碳吸收、减少暴雨径流，并显著提升栖息地和生物多样性。

ex.s: Sometimes she prepares traditional Brazilian dishes ___48___ her native home; other times she ___49___ dinner courses with her favorite beers.
ex.t: 有时,她会准备传统的巴西菜肴____48____,她家乡;有时,她会____49____用她最喜欢的啤酒吃晚餐。

ex.s: In addition, there’s no need for pesticides and other chemicals that pollute traditional farms and the surrounding environment.
ex.t: 此外，也不需要那些会污染传统农场及周边环境的有毒农药和其他化学品。

ex.s: Each town has its own traditional ____30____, and every family keeps a recipe passed from one generation to another.
ex.t: 每个城镇都有自己____30____的传统,每个家庭都有代代相传的食谱。

ex.s: Practice a traditional dance.
ex.t: 练习一种传统舞蹈。

ex.s: He suggested I think about the difference between endings that I wanted for the characters and endings that were right for the characters, endings that satisfied the story even if they didn’t have a traditionally positive outcome.
ex.t: 他建议我思考：我想要的结局和适合角色的结局之间的区别——那些让故事圆满的结局，即便不是传统意义上的美满结局。

ex.s: Though DIY has traditionally been seen as male hobby, the research shows it is women now leading the charge.
ex.t: 尽管DIY传统上被视为男性爱好，研究显示如今是女性在带头。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，约一半英国消费者想以某种方式改变或改善自己的烹饪。

ex.s: Strictly follow traditional recipes when cooking.
ex.t: 在烹饪时严格遵循传统食谱.

ex.s: Growing up in San Francisco, Grace Young used to watch her father shop daily in Chinatown for whatever he needed to make traditional Chinese meals at home.
ex.t: 在旧金山长大的杨格蕾斯，过去常看父亲每天在唐人街买做传统中餐所需的任何东西。

ex.s: Many instructors continue to teach using traditional lectures, which lead to lower success rates.
ex.t: 许多教员继续使用传统讲座教学,这导致成功率降低。

ex.s: Presenting the best of the West End along with the pick of the UK’s touring shows, the New Theatre is Cardiff’s oldest surviving traditional theatre.
ex.t: 呈现西区最佳作品以及英国巡演剧目精选，新剧院是卡迪夫现存最古老的传统剧院。

ex.s: High levels of knowledge can make people too attached to traditional ways of viewing problems across fields the arts, sciences, and politics.
ex.t: 高知识水平可能让人们在艺术、科学和政治等各领域过于执着于传统的看问题方式。

ex.s: He enjoys the traditional way of life.
ex.t: 他享受传统生活方式。

ex.s: We will wander in traditional small towns and end our tour with an exceptional museum in Shanghai.
ex.t: 我们将在传统小镇中漫步，并以上海一座别具一格的博物馆结束行程。

ex.s: It is traditional to bring a gift to a housewarming party.
ex.t: 带礼物去暖房派对是传统做法。

ex.s: He asked the workers to use traditional techniques to make the bricks into walls, roofs and corridors.
ex.t: 他要求工人用传统工艺把砖砌成墙、屋顶和走廊。

ex.s: “They’re learning to do traditional dances.
ex.t: 他们正在学习传统舞蹈。

ex.s: Words formed by combining other words are called compounds, for example, 1______ (a friend that you contact by writing, traditionally using a pen) and 2_______ (known by many people).
ex.t: 结合其他单词形成的单词被称为复合词,例如:1      (你通过写作接触的朋友,传统上使用笔头)和2       (许多人都知道).

ex.s: With pleasant flavours and scents, and coming in a variety of colours, fruit and herbal teas make a nice change to traditional teas.
ex.t: 以愉快的香味和香味,以多种颜色出现,果实和草药茶对传统茶叶做出了很好的改变.

ex.s: We all love roast beef and vegetables, but Mum says we'd better not eat too much roast food as it may make us suffer from heat inside our bodies, according to traditional Chinese medicine.
ex.t: 我们都爱烤牛肉和蔬菜，但妈妈说根据中医，最好别吃太多烧烤食物，会让我们体内上火。

ex.s: It was the first traditional Chinese festival added to UNESCO’s List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
ex.t: 它是第一个被列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录的中国传统节日。

ex.s: Traditionally, it was a chance to give thanks for a good harvest.
ex.t: 传统上,这是一个感谢丰收的机会。

defs.def: following older methods and ideas rather than modern or different ones 传统的；因袭的；守旧的

ex.s: You’ll compete with fewer tourists, save money, experience a different side of a popular place, and boost the economy when tourism is traditionally slower.
ex.t: 你会与更少的游客竞争、省钱、体验热门地点的不同一面，并在传统淡季提振当地经济。

ex.s: The menu in this beautiful colonial house includes traditional Thai cuisine combined with modern cooking methods.
ex.t: 这座美丽的殖民时期宅邸的菜单包括传统泰国菜与现代烹饪方法的结合。

ex.s: That project, which I could complete from my sofa instead of in the burning heat of the desert, not only survived the lockdown but worked where traditional methods didn’t.
ex.t: 不仅在封锁中幸存下来, 而且在传统方法没有的地方工作。

ex.s: “We can’t seem to make up our minds whether we want a modern city or a traditional one.
ex.t: 我们似乎拿不定主意，到底是想要一座现代城市还是传统城市。

ex.s: It is different from traditional tourism because it allows the traveler to become 61 (educate) about the areas - both in terms of geographical conditions and cultural characteristics, and often provides money for conservation and benefits the 62 (develop) of the local areas.
ex.t: 它不同于传统旅游，因为它让旅行者受到____61（educate）关于该地区——无论是地理条件还是文化特征，并且常常为保护提供资金，造福当地的____62（develop）。
